items.author: Trump
items.text: BIG NEWS! Micron, a truly GREAT American Company, and one of the “HOTTEST” anywhere in the World, has announced a HISTORIC $250 MILLION Investment in TRUMP ACCOUNTS. This incredible gesture, made by Micron’s fantastic CEO, Sanjay Mehrotra, will make many children extremely happy some day in the not too distant future. This is the BIGGEST CORPORATE Investment of its kind, and will help jumpstart the American Dream for these fabulous children as we celebrate America's 250th Anniversary! items.summary_cn: Trump再度发文高调称赞美光(MU)是'美国伟大公司、世界最热门之一'，称2.5亿美元投资为史上最大规模企业同类投资，构成强烈背书信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: How about this? Micron, a GREAT American Company, announced that they are putting in 250 Million Dollars into the Trump Accounts for the future benefit of children, and their stock went up 9 points today. Thank you Micron! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump公开表扬并感谢美光(MU)向Trump Accounts投资2.5亿美元，并称其股票当日上涨9点，强烈背书美光。

items.text: Elon Musk shuts down ‘4D chess’ theory on Tesla Optimus production

items.text: The town that Elon Musk built

items.author: Trump
items.text: Just as I promised, Oil Prices are plummeting FAST, and Gas Prices at the pump are dropping too, but not as fast as they should be. As we approach America’s 250th Birthday, I am pleased to announce that a VERY smart Retailer, located throughout the Northeast, is stepping up, and wishing the People of Philadelphia a “Happy Birthday!” On July 3rd, the Freedom Fuel Network will be lowering gas prices at 25 “FREEDOM FUEL” Stations across the Greater Philadelphia Area. This Retailer is taking the lead, and others should follow. They are doing this because they love the U.S.A. We are proud to celebr
items.summary_cn: Trump宣称油价正在快速下跌，费城一零售商在美国250周年庆期间下调25个加油站油价，对能源/消费板块有间接信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Hegseth: We must spend big on defense to save America’s economic might: https://nypost.com/2026/06/23/opinion/hegseth-we-must-spend-big-on-defense-to-save-americas-economic-might/
items.summary_cn: Hegseth(配合Trump政府)主张美国应大举增加国防开支以维护经济实力，对国防军工板块构成利好政策信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: DOGE self-deletes on July 4th. The grand experiment fell apart long before that.
items.summary_cn: 报道称DOGE将于7月4日自我解散，'伟大实验'早已失败，对政府效率改革主题构成负面信号。
